CINEMATIC MODE - v32

BOOT SEQUENCE
Every time HUD Live starts, each display boots in about four seconds:
- J.A.R.V.I.S. displays: the arc reactor ignites with a shockwave and spins up,
  rings and clock come into focus, a light sweep crosses the screen, headings
  decode, panels materialize and REACTOR OUTPUT counts to 100%.
- S.H.I.E.L.D. displays: the insignia authenticates in the middle of the board
  (AUTHENTICATING... ACCESS GRANTED), countries light up west to east as the scan
  crosses the map, the reference cities ping in and GRID CALIBRATION reaches 100%.
- A boot console types this PC's real processor, graphics, memory, storage,
  telemetry, voice and assistant status. The SHIELD console stays factual too:
  the map is an offline schematic and nothing is tracked.
Tray > HUD appearance > Boot sequence at startup turns it off.
Tray > HUD appearance > Play boot sequence runs it again.
It plays only in Full animation mode. Reduced, Off, a paused HUD and the Windows
reduced-motion setting skip straight to the finished HUD.

SPOKEN GREETING
When the boot reaches "online", JARVIS greets you aloud with the time, today's
date, the weather (when web search is on and a weather city is saved) and a
system check: processor and memory load, plus anything that needs attention
(a drive over 90% full, memory over 90%, a hot GPU, a low battery).
If the primary display uses S.H.I.E.L.D., the greeting welcomes you as Agent.
The greeting is skipped when a fullscreen game or app has paused the HUD.
Tray > JARVIS voice > Spoken greeting at startup turns it off.

VOICE-REACTIVE DISPLAYS
While JARVIS speaks, the reactor moves with his real voice: radial voice bars
ripple around the rings and the core glows. HUD Live measures the loudness of
each spoken reply as it plays, so the motion follows the words.
On S.H.I.E.L.D. displays a comms trace runs along the bottom of the map and the
insignia glows in time with the voice.
The voice visuals follow the FPS limit, pause rules and the Reactor rings
setting, and are off in Reduced and Off animation modes.

VOICE (say Jarvis first)
- Jarvis power up / boot sequence / wake up   replays the boot, then greets you
- Jarvis good morning / good afternoon / good evening / I'm home
- Jarvis status report                        time, weather and system check
